gaps.lead: Darius soon recovered after the operation on his knee and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.sentence: After the operation on his knee, Darius ___ and was able to rejoin the team.
gaps.explanation: 'Recovered soon' is expressed with the noun: 'made a quick/fast/rapid recovery'.

gaps.lead: The company is unable to guarantee an allocated car-parking space to all employees.
gaps.sentence: The company's employees shouldn't ___ allocated a car-parking space.
gaps.explanation: 'Count on being allocated' means rely on receiving.

gaps.lead: The instructions only made sense after she had read them twice.
gaps.sentence: The instructions ___ sense until she had read them twice.
gaps.explanation: made sense only after = didn't make sense until.

gaps.lead: Although he is remarkably rich, he lives very simply.
gaps.explanation: Although he may be rich → Rich as (he) may be — fronted adjective + as + may.

gaps.lead: 'You copied my design!' she told him.
'I broke the window,' the boy said.
gaps.sentence: When caught, the boy ___ the window.
gaps.explanation: admit + -ing, or admit having + past participle for the earlier action.
